items.stem: At a conceptual level, a diffusion image model generates an image by:

options.text: Starting from noise and iteratively denoising it toward output guided by the prompt
options.rationale: Correct: diffusion models iteratively denoise from random noise toward a conditioned result.

options.text: Copying and pasting pieces of specific training images together
options.rationale: It does not stitch retrieved training images together.

options.text: Looking up the exact image in a database
options.rationale: There is no retrieval of a stored exact image.

items.explanation: Correct: diffusion models iteratively denoise from random noise toward a conditioned result.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support responsible, honest use of AI-generated art? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Disclosing meaningful AI involvement when it matters to the audience or context
options.rationale: Correct: honest disclosure respects audiences and many platform/contest rules.

options.text: Checking the rights and permissions of any reference inputs you supply
options.rationale: Correct: inputs you feed in may carry rights and consent obligations.

options.text: Presenting generated work as a hand-made photograph to win a photo contest
Assuming all outputs are automatically free of any attribution duty
options.rationale: Rights and attribution duties can still apply.

items.explanation: Correct: honest disclosure respects audiences and many platform/contest rules.

items.stem: Fixing the random 'seed' together with the same prompt and parameters is useful because it:

options.text: Makes a generation reproducible, so you can make controlled variations
options.rationale: Correct: a fixed seed and settings reproduce or systematically vary a result.

options.text: Removes the need to curate output

items.explanation: Correct: a fixed seed and settings reproduce or systematically vary a result.
